data.body: Probe A implemented (skill edit, single line, positive-form): plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md Step 2.25 HARD-GATE block now opens with 'Dispatch every batch in this step. User authorization at skill entry covers all dispatches required by Step 2.25.' This co-locates the execute-to-completion rule with the dispatch decision site, testing the Instruction Locality (#16) hypothesis. The phrasing is pure positive form (no bypass enumeration) to avoid pink-elephant interference per the white-elephant rule from skill-refactor/SKILL.md (commit d62ce71243). To validate Probe A's hypothesis: run a future /dso:brainstorm pass with a seed that triggers ≥20 cross-epic batches; observe whether the agent dispatches all batches without surfacing a pause/cost option. If yes → Instruction Locality confirmed as primary residual primer; iterate to Probe B-E only if not. If no → falsified; proceed to Probe B (dispatch-count obfuscation).
